personal_information.headline: Computational & Mathematical Physicist | High-Performance Computing & AI

professional_summary: Computational and mathematical physicist specialized in theoretical and numerical modeling of complex stochastic dynamical systems across scales. Research foundation uniting statistical physics, high-dimensional statistical inference, and large-scale scientific computing. Proven expertise in HPC, Big Data, and AI by architecting and deploying scalable, distributed systems for high-throughput research and enterprise workloads, spanning multi-node GPU Deep Learning pipelines on Tier-0 supercomputers (CINECA Leonardo).

work_experience.employer: Istituto Nazionale di Oceanografia e di Geofisica Sperimentale (OGS) & Università degli Studi di Trieste (UniTS)
responsibilities_and_achievements: Architected and deployed automated ML seismic data processing pipelines on Italy's Tier-0 CINECA Leonardo supercomputer with dynamic job submission across 32+ cores/node using SLURM, MPI, and multi-node GPU parallelization, achieving 94% accuracy on high-throughput production workloads.

Investigated rank-one estimation in the spiked Wigner model under Prof. Jean Barbier; developed a prior-independent scheduler for Approximate Message Passing (AMP) Onsager corrections to characterize Bayes-optimal signal recovery under structured noise.

work_experience.employer: ORACLE de México, SA de CV
responsibilities_and_achievements: Architected and deployed a production backend and customer-facing API for automated analytics and diagnostic patch recommendation workflows.
Mentored junior developers and established engineering code review practices.
Developed thermal-process simulations for Multi Jet Fusion 3D printing technology.
Validated computational models against experimental materials-science benchmarks.
Conducted computational physics and Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) simulations for phase transition analysis and emergent phenomena in complex systems.
Researched the Totally Asymmetric Simple Exclusion Process (TASEP) and Global Magnetization Conserved Spin Exchange Dynamics under Dr. Soham Biswas.
Researched computational algorithms for the local detection of community structures in complex networks under Dr. Satu Elisa Schaeffer.

education.description: Built distributed training/inference pipelines across multi-node GPU clusters (MPI/CUDA) for large seismic datasets; engineered a custom validation framework using bipartite optimization and weighted similarity scoring.

education.institution: Scuola Internazionale Superiore di Studi Avanzati (SISSA)
education.description: Developed an end-to-end ML pipeline for real-time earthquake detection; architected HPC-optimized workflows with Transformers and CNNs to ingest continuous data streams at scale.
Completed coursework in Universal Biology and Active Matter, Probability and Information Theory, Mathematical Economics and Game Theory, Computational Neuroscience, and Reinforcement Learning.

Simulated complex social systems with 1D Ising spin models integrating Kawasaki and Schelling dynamics; quantified critical exponents via finite-size scaling (z approximately 2.48, lambda approximately 1.15, theta approximately 0.46).

education.institution: Instituto Tecnológico y de Estudios Superiores de Occidente (ITESO)

projects.name: Automated Seismic Data Processing Pipeline
projects.description: End-to-end HPC pipeline for seismic event detection: waveform acquisition, ML-based phase picking (SeisBench), octree-based association (PyOcto), and 3D hypocenter location (NonLinLoc). Dynamic SLURM job generation with template-based configuration and GNU Make orchestration.

projects.name: Event Matching & Validation Framework
projects.description: Novel validation system using Hungarian algorithm-based bipartite optimization with custom weighted similarity metrics (location, magnitude, origin time). Enables rigorous comparison against authoritative catalogs (INGV). Open-source contribution for reproducible seismology research.

projects.name: High-Dimensional Statistical Inference & Approximate Message Passing
projects.description: Investigated rank-one estimation in spiked Wigner matrix models under Prof. Jean Barbier at ICTP. Engineered a prior-independent Onsager reaction scheduler for Approximate Message Passing (AMP), establishing recovery thresholds and analyzing fundamental algorithmic phase transitions under structured noise.

projects.name: Additive Manufacturing Thermal Simulator
projects.description: High-fidelity finite element simulation of powder bed fusion processes. Validated against experimental thermal imaging data from HP's Multi Jet Fusion production line.

projects.name: Global Magnetization Conserved Spin Exchange Dynamics as a Social Dynamics Simulation Engine
projects.description: Monte Carlo framework for studying segregation and opinion dynamics in complex networks. Implemented Ising-based models with Kawasaki-Schelling hybrid dynamics and characterized critical exponents via finite-size scaling. Research supervised by Dr. Soham Biswas.

projects.name: Totally Asymmetric Simple Exclusion Process (TASEP)
projects.description: Simulated established TASEP results and modeled the effects of a traffic light using Fortran and GNUPlot, under the supervision of Dr. Soham Biswas.

projects.name: Local Detection of Community Structures
projects.description: Introductory research during a Research Assistantship at Universidad Autónoma de Nuevo León (UANL), on local detection of community structures in complex networks under Dr. Satu Elisa Schaeffer.
